completion_rule: A result envelope means the handler returned a domain result. Inspect its posture/result and evidence; it does not establish Work satisfaction or admission except the exact observed admitted transaction.
deadline_rule: Use the strictest caller/policy/message deadline and budget. No effect begins after expiry; after possible effect, expose uncertainty and inspect/reconcile.
description: Export selected portable original content and complete dependencies
idempotency_rule: Exact same fingerprint returns or points to the recorded result after current read authorization; a different fingerprint conflicts; pending/uncertain keys never redispatch.
postconditions: Return a managed generation receipt binding exported package bytes and dependencies.
Exported source admission evidence does not admit the package in another target.
preconditions: Verify selected original bytes and the complete required dependency closure.
Resolve export destination from the exact export contract; exclude credentials/session memory.
